messages:
Priya (ACME): Hi — we created a service account under our SSO org and generated an API key, but every request returns 403 with an 'invalid_api_key' body. Console shows our subscription as active (Team plan). Example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 403. x-request-id: req_0abC1234. Can someone help debug?

Sam (Support): Thanks — can you paste the full response body you got and the response headers (request id)? Also which tenant ID/email is this under? 403s can be either auth or entitlement/plan gating.

Priya (ACME): Response body: `{ "error": "invalid_api_key", "message": "Api key not found" }`. Response headers: `x-request-id: req_0abC1234`, `x-proxy-error: 403`. Tenant shown in console: `tenant_abc123`. SKU in billing console: Team (paid). We only enabled embeddings for internal infra — not sure if that matters.

Ava (SRE): Checked logs for `req_0abC1234` — the request hits the API gateway, gateway calls entitlement-service -> entitlement-service returns 403 (feature gated) and the gateway currently maps that to the generic `invalid_api_key` error. Snippet from service logs:```
[2026-03-16T14:09:45Z] api-gateway req=req_0abC1234 tenant=tenant_abc123 action=embed
[2026-03-16T14:09:45Z] entitlement-service tenant=tenant_abc123 feature=private_embeddings result=DENY code=ENTITLEMENT_MISSING reason=plan_tier
[2026-03-16T14:09:45Z] api-gateway proxied-error req=req_0abC1234 mapped=invalid_api_key -> client 403
```Root cause: the embedding endpoint for 'private_embeddings' is behind a feature flag reserved for Pro+ SKUs. Your tenant is on Team so the entitlement check fails. Gateway currently conflates entitlement denials with auth failures which is the confusing part.

Sam (Support): Short-term options: 1) We can enable the feature for your tenant if you want to test (requires ops approval). 2) Billing can upgrade your tenant to Pro (or enable trial add-on) so entitlement succeeds. 3) If you need a quick hack, create a service account under a tenant that has the feature enabled (not ideal). To refresh any cached entitlement state after a billing change run (internal): `POST /admin/tenants/tenant_abc123/entitlements/refresh` with admin token — that clears the entitlement cache TTL so the gateway re-checks immediately.

Priya (ACME): We'd prefer to avoid upgrade if possible — can you run the refresh after you enable the feature flag temporarily? Also what prevents created API keys from being blocked if console shows active subscription?

Ava (SRE): The console's billing status shows active subscription but feature-level entitlements are separate. After plan change there's a short sync window and a per-tenant feature mask. The two common failure modes we see: (a) entitlement-check returns DENY because feature isn't in SKU, (b) tenant sync race where billing service updated but entitlement cache still has old flags. Both surfaced as 403 -> invalid key in client.

Sam (Support): I'll open a billing escalation to get a trial flag applied while we investigate. Action items: Sam -> request provisional feature enable for tenant_abc123; Ava -> run entitlement refresh once billing confirms; Billing bot -> confirm trial/quota change. Priya please confirm you want us to proceed with temporary enable.

Priya (ACME): Yes please enable temporarily and run the refresh. Also please document the error mapping so our engineers don't waste time next time. :thumbsup:

Sam (Support): Will do. I'll also file a follow-up with Product to change the gateway mapping so entitlement denials return a clear `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` code and message (ETA 2 business days). For now we'll proceed with temporary enable + refresh and update you here when done. :eyes:

Billing bot: Noted — created billing ticket #B-4321 to approve a 7-day trial of Pro features for tenant_abc123, requesting ops ticket for entitlement flip.

Ava (SRE): Done — entitlement refresh triggered at 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z. Please retry your curl and paste the new x-request-id if you still see a 403.

Priya (ACME): Retried — new request `x-request-id: req_0abC1240` returned 200! Thanks everyone. Please keep us posted on the mapping change.

Sam (Support): Great — closing loop. We'll message when product deploys the clearer error. If anything else crops up please re-open. :white_check_mark:
